series.source: Yahoo Finance chart HYG/LQD daily closes (ratio)
series.rationale: Credit risk appetite: HY vs IG relative. HY outperformance (ratio↑) → risk-on for AUDUSD; ratio↓ → credit stress / risk-off. ≠ commodity ToT; ≠ VIXCLS equity-vol densify twin; Owner W26 reopen.
